notes.title: DevLog #04 - New UI and accessibility
notes.notes:
Hello fellow tycoons! It's time for another update on the development of Ad Agency Tycoon, the ultimate game for marketing enthusiasts. We have some exciting news to share with you today!

New UI for Accessibility

As part of our commitment to inclusivity, we have implemented a new user interface (UI) for Ad Agency Tycoon that focuses on simplicity and accessibility, particularly for colorblind players. We understand the importance of making our game accessible to as many players as possible, and we believe that everyone should be able to enjoy the game regardless of their visual abilities.

Our new UI features a color palette that is designed to be easily distinguishable for players with colorblindness. We have taken into consideration different types of colorblindness, such as red-green and blue-yellow colorblindness, and made sure that the UI elements are clearly visible and distinguishable without relying solely on color. We have also made sure that text and icons are easily readable, and that the overall design is clean and uncluttered for a seamless user experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206404/b54e09b691b02a4ebc5a31601842b737c3d2ebd6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206404/9119f11627cdb3145adf1c57e873dc3c3ca94817.png[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates as we approach the official launch of Ad Agency Tycoon. We can't wait for you to experience the thrill of running your own advertising agency and creating successful marketing campaigns. Thank you for joining us on this exciting journey, and we look forward to seeing you in the game!

notes.title: Ad Agency Tycoon v0.6
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!

Since our last DevLog, we've changed a lot in Ad Agency Tycoon. Lots of basic mechanics, things that have stayed the same since the initial release of Early Access. But once we're done with these changes, we ask ourselves: Are there any others that deserve a little more attention?

In addition to the ad creation system, many elements of the game needed tweaking. Employees. The customizations. Some annoying bugs that have been with us for a while.

So we spent the last 4 months fixing the vast majority of bugs, changing basic mechanics, and everything to turn Ad Agency Tycoon into a new game. A new game for those who thought we needed changes, but also the same game for those who liked the way it was.

[b]Ad Agency Tycoon v0.6 is the first of a long step in restructuring the game, so that we can finally move on to the final release version[/b]. We hope you like it.


List of changes:

- Skill Tree are now Advertising Elements
[list]
[*] No more employees needed for the old skill system!
[*] Discover new advertising features, and customize yours!
[/list]
- Restructuring the creation of advertisements
[list]
[*] No need to advertise in stages anymore
[*] Do all the ad at once, and while it's being produced, do other tasks
[*] You can now see what each Advertising Element does during advertising production!
[*] Feedback? It has its own room now! Put an employee there and get better feedback!
[/list]
- Restructuring of scenario customizations
[list]
[*] Few customizations? Problem solved!
[*] Now the floor is also customizable!
[*] Want a colorful environment? Now each room is individually customizable!
[/list]
- Restructuring of reputation calculation
[list]
[*] Everything more simplified!
[*] It's the average of the ratings of your last 5 advertisements!
[/list]
- Restructuring of the inventory system
[list]
[*] Items disappearing and returning? No more!
[/list]
- Restructuring of the employee system
[list]
[*] Didn't like the Assignments system? It's gone!
[*] Now every employee has skills! Specialize each one and get the best out of them!
[/list]
- Restructuring of the room system
[list]
[*] Fixed rooms? No more!
[*] Your rooms are where you choose! And any color you want!
[/list]
- New Contracts system
[list]
[*] Looking for quick cash? Contracts can be a good option!
[*] Put employees in the Creativity Room, and earn extra income!
[/list]
- Other things
[list]
[*] We don't even know which and how many bugs we fixed, but there were certainly dozens!
[*] Reduced game disk size. We know that our game takes up little space, but it's always good to reduce, isn't it?
[*] New item: Printer.
[/list]

notes.title: DevLog #03 - "This game is repetitive"
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!

We're making the biggest changes in Ad Agency Tycoon history. But to explain what changes we are making, we first have to explain why we are making them.

We are always reading Ad Agency Tycoon reviews and refund reasons, and by far the most complaints are about "this game is repetitive". Every new update, we add new tools and gameplay so that players can have new possibilities for paths to follow. But we never realized that, even with new paths within the game, the first step is always freelance advertising. And in nearly two years of Early Access, we've never touched the game's foundation, thinking it was good enough.

We were wrong.

As soon as SimFest was over, we discussed what we could implement again, but we ended up coming to the conclusion that we should review the base of the game. And that's what we're doing.

We are working on something that we haven't changed in years, and we believe that the game will become much more fluid and dynamic, with the true opening of new paths for the player, not requiring that the first step always be in freelance advertisements.

We won't say much more about what's new, but we will show you what will change in what already exists. Expect an update soon. Until then, give feedback, join our Discord and participate in our community!

notes.title: DevLog #01
notes.notes:
Hey guys! There is a lot of news out there!

We are happy to announce another big update! We worked on visual and sound improvements and started to pave the way for the implementation of new mechanics.
Among these improvements, here are our main ideas:

[b]Targeted Audience:[/b] We are paving the way for implementing the Target Audience selection mechanic, a hugely important feature in the advertising world, and which we want to bring to the game in a fun way!

[b]Companies by contract:[/b] Previously there was only the possibility of producing advertisements in a "freelancer" way. Now we want to make available the idea that companies can hire your agency for a longer period of time, requiring planning and use of new resources and strategies.

[b]New soundtrack: [/b]We are delighted to announce the participation of musician Kevin Luiz da Silva, who will be responsible from this update for commanding all the sound of our game, which will feature exclusive tracks and sound effects produced by the new member of BarCode Studios! Welcome Kelvin!

[b]New "Finished Advertising" HUD :[/b] This is perhaps our biggest visual improvement in recent years. We've carefully planned a new, much better looking HUD that will help define the style we want to achieve in the game in the final project. In addition, it contains better organization of information and content disposition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206404/48018fd99d1b15edfffcbba81e119c6290a514c0.png[/img]

[b]Global Random Events: [/b]This feature will help in the player's sense of time progression. Here we want to bring events that happen in the world while the player takes care of his agency, these events will influence the player's decisions and strategies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206404/be6d368f8043fd37833112cc99dc1b3fca4f853f.png[/img]

In addition to the new features described above, we will be implementing new companies, new pet skins, a new employee and new audio skills.

Thanks for your support, don't forget to keep sending us feedbacks and ideas. 

~Kaminski, Lead Artist.

notes.title: Ad Agency Tycoon v0.2
Ad Agency Tycoon v0.2 to be released 21th September!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We are happy to announce that Ad Agency Tycoon v0.2 will be out on September 21st! The update will focus on new ways to invest your money, as well as balance profits. The game will also undergo a major restructuring of the HUD with a new visual identity, we will adjust the duration of the stages and implement new visual elements displayed during the creation of the advertisements. We will also implement reference guides: information about each element of the game when hovering over the content!
The following updates remain focused on correcting any bugs, and implementing new elements related to the theme of the update. Don't forget to give your feedback on the Steam forums, as one of the implementations of this update comes from a player's suggestion!

~Diamantino

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.1.4
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
In the last few days, we released a bunch of tiny updates to the game. They were mostly game breaking glitches that needed urgent attention and quick patches. From now on, we are going to be releasing daily updates along with patch notes. Check below the patch notes for all our updates so far:
-    Now the game imports the current language data from Steam. You can also select your language by clicking on the game icon at the Steam Library
-    The turn shifts are now visible next to the clock animation
-    Now less XP is needed to level up
-    Better and clearer tutorials
-    New Game and Load Game button in the main menu
-    Fixed: not loading translation correctly
-    Fixed: not deleting the saved games after a game over
-    Fixed: ‘Sold Out’ and ‘Hired’ status were not showed correctly in Scenario 2
-    Fixed: not saving volume choice in ‘options’ after reloading the game
-    Fixed: Tutorial kept showing up at the beginning up after finished
-    Fixed: Road Map button did not work correctly
-    Fixed: not being able to progress in the game
-    Minor optimizations
-    Some grammar mistakes were noticed and fixed

~Kaminski
